The 2025-03-27 and 2026-03-24 items are the annual continuation notices (90 FR 14327; 91 FR 15511); each says that Executive Order 14148 revoked Executive Order 14110 and, in the same sentence, continues the emergency declared in Executive Order 13694, so neither revokes this order or any clause of it.
